pages.title: Volume and range
pages.text: Volume, range and distance fade adjust live without restarting playback.$(br2)Range is capped by server policy.$(br2)Entering range joins the current playback position.

pages.title: Distance fade
pages.text: 0% keeps full volume until the range boundary.$(br2)100% fades gradually with distance.$(br2)A linked Volume controller can override manual volume until its last input is removed.

pages.title: Your listening
pages.text: Open Settings, then Your listening settings.$(br2)These choices only affect you across all speakers and save automatically on this device.$(br2)You can change them even when you cannot control the speaker.

pages.title: Timed fades
pages.text: Entry fade duration and Exit fade duration set how many milliseconds sound takes to fade when crossing audible range.$(br2)Each accepts 0-5000 ms; 0 disables that timed transition.

pages.title: Fade behavior
pages.text: They are separate from the speaker's Distance fade (%) slider.$(br2)Stop and disconnect still end audio immediately.

pages.title: Stereo and cache
pages.text: Stereo playback preserves left/right channels and centres audio on you; range and cone volume still apply.$(br2)Stop and play again to apply a changed stereo choice.

pages.title: Local cache
pages.text: Audio cache size sets your local disk budget, 64-4096 MiB.$(br2)Old cached downloads are removed as downloads finish; server originals are kept.
